subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What media-store and sandbox-staging size-limit contract should OpenClaw support, including default, hard maximum, config location, and precedence with existing mediaMaxMb settings?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but the durable fix adds or changes configuration at a sandbox/media resource boundary where repository policy requires product and security judgment.

options.title: Define a bounded shared limit
options.body: Add a documented, validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire affected media paths to the same resolved value.

options.title: Land only the Telegram slice
options.body: Review the focused Telegram PR for immediate outbound document relief while keeping this issue open for the broader store and sandbox-staging contract.

options.title: Reject configurability
options.body: Keep the fixed 5 MiB core cap and document that larger files need per-path exceptions rather than a general store/sandbox setting.

recommendation.title: Define a bounded shared limit
recommendation.body: Add a documented, validated store/staging limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire affected media paths to the same resolved value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses sandbox/media security boundaries, and steipete has the clearest sampled history on the sandbox staging split.
